hypothesis: A reachable merchant has a problem not well served by current providers
test: Map 3 provider workflows and interview 5 merchants after outreach approval
success_metric: At least 2 merchants describe same costly unmet workflow; specific switching condition recorded
negative_action: Pause commercial build if no repeated problem
next_action: Prepare evidence collection; obtain assets/access and outreach authority

hypothesis: A verified SKU has positive contribution with safety and fitment evidence
test: Obtain supplier dossier, sample fit test and 3 shipping quotes
success_metric: Documented fit/safety; positive downside contribution including returns and acquisition
negative_action: Do not list if safety or contribution fails
next_action: Prepare evidence collection; obtain assets/access and outreach authority

hypothesis: Agents value a faithful cinematic tour enough to commission a pilot
test: Compare capture/hybrid/generative output on one real property; interview 10 agents
success_metric: Zero material geometry defects; 3/10 give specific priced pilot intent
negative_action: Revise proposition or pause; no platform build
next_action: Prepare evidence collection; obtain assets/access and outreach authority

hypothesis: Durable AI routines can operate paper research reliably
test: Replay historical sessions, stale data, retries and partial failures
success_metric: No duplicate paper orders; all readiness gates and recovery tests pass
next_action: Prepare evidence collection; obtain assets/access and outreach authority

hypothesis: A narrow digital workflow has unmet paid demand
test: Audit 15 listings across 3 candidate niches; interview 10 target buyers
success_metric: 3 independent repeated pain examples and 3 priced purchase-intent commitments in one niche
negative_action: Do not create products; change niche or stop
next_action: Prepare evidence collection; obtain assets/access and outreach authority

hypothesis: Manchester customers will pay enough for wall-printing jobs to support a machine purchase or lease
test: Obtain three comparable supplier quotes and service terms, produce or commission one verified sample and secure three priced customer commitments before selecting equipment
success_metric: Three comparable written quotes, acceptable sample quality and at least three specific priced commitments with positive downside contribution
negative_action: Do not buy or lease equipment; revise the offer or stop
next_action: Use the approved supplier-question set and obtain owner authority before sending outreach

hypothesis: Independent Manchester short-stay operators will pay for an authorized listing and booking-growth service
test: Interview ten operators and compare referral, management and marketing-only models without taking bookings or guest funds
success_metric: Three operators confirm the same paid need and one signs a written, compliant pilot authority
negative_action: Do not publish listings or accept bookings; revise the commercial model or stop
next_action: Build a Manchester operator sample and solicitor questions before any outreach

hypothesis: A clinician-led clear-aligner service can secure compliant capacity and sufficient qualified local demand
test: Confirm named clinicians and scope, compare three compliant premises options and interview twenty prospective patients using non-clinical discovery questions
success_metric: Clinical lead accepts governance responsibility, one viable premises route is documented and five qualified prospects request a clinician consultation at a stated price range
negative_action: Do not market treatment, collect clinical data or take patient payment
next_action: Identify clinical operators and commission regulatory and premises feasibility review

hypothesis: One compliant product can produce repeatable demand with positive downside contribution
test: Score twenty candidate products, validate the top three with customer evidence and run one capped no-stock or sample-first demand test
success_metric: One product has verified safety/supplier evidence, at least five priced purchase-intent signals and positive contribution after returns and acquisition
negative_action: Do not import inventory or publish unverified claims; change product or stop
next_action: Create the product-screening matrix and evidence requirements

hypothesis: A bounded AI sales assistant can improve dealer response speed without making unauthorized claims or sending messages autonomously
test: Map workflows with five dealers and run an offline evaluation on synthetic enquiries with human-approved responses
success_metric: Two dealers request a controlled pilot, every test response preserves dealer scope and no finance, availability or price claim lacks source evidence
negative_action: Keep outbound delivery disabled; revise controls or stop
next_action: Prepare dealer interview and synthetic-evaluation packs before outreach
